title: Clarkdale Cement Plant as egress to secret facility

tellings.quote: there's an egress point into this whole secret facility called the Clarkdale Cement Plant.

plain: A cement plant in Clarkdale, Arizona, is said to be an exit point from a hidden secret facility, which the episode treats as a UFO base. The journalist Ross Coulthart tells this, passing on what a source told him. If true, an ordinary-looking industrial site would be the doorway to an underground program.
